newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: SOCCER-YUGOSLAVIA NAME SQUAD TO MEET CZECHS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-YUGOSLAVIA NAME SQUAD TO MEET CZECHS.

text.p: Coach Slobodan Santrac named a 20-man squad for Yugoslavia's World Cup qualifier against the Czech Republic next week and said he had great faith in his players.

"I absolutely believe in the players I have chosen," he said ahead of the match in Prague on April 2. "Their quality and the undisputable attraction of trying to beat the European championship finalists promises at least an equal game."
Regular goalkeeper Zvonko Milojevic is unavailable for selection for personal reasons.
Ivica Kralj of Partizan Belgrade and Dragoje Lekovic of Scottish side Kilmarnock are the two goalkeepers in the squad.
Goalkeepers - Ivica Kralj (Partizan Belgrade), Dragoje Lekovic (Kilmarnock, Scotland)

Defenders - Goran Djorovic (Red Star Belgrade), Dejan Stefanovic (Sheffield Wednesday, England), Miroslav Djukic (Deportivo Coruna, Spain), Risto Vidakovic (Real Betis, Spain), Zoran Mirkovic (Atalanta, Italy), Sinisa Mihajloviv (Sampdoria, Italy)

Midfielders - Dragan Stojkovic (Grampus Eight, Japan), Branko Brnovic (Espanol, Spain), Dejan Govedarica (Volendam, Netherlands), Slavisa Jokanovic (Tenerife, Spain), Vladimir Jugovic (Juventus, Italy), Albert Nadj (Real Betis, Spain), Ljubinko Drulovic (Porto, Portugal), Dragan Ciric (Partizan Belgrade)
Forwards - Predrag Mijatovic (Real Madrid, Spain), Dejan Savicevic (AC Milan, Italy), Savo Milosevic (Aston Villa, England), Anto Drobnjak (Bastia, France)
